title: No column supports the craft's 53-ft floor

tellings.quote: And there is nothing that was visually witnessed on the bottom level when he peeked that is a supporting column holding that 53-ft diameter floor.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in 1988 and 1989 at a secret site in Nevada called S-4, is said to have seen no column holding up the 53-foot-wide floor of one craft when he peeked into its bottom level. A researcher named Luigi Vendittelli, who spent two days with Lazar, makes the point from Lazar's account. He says there is nothing "supporting" that floor, which would point to building methods unlike ours.
